g.title: crate Arvane: the public facade of the Arvane layer.
crate::asset Explicit image and font services exposed by the Arvane facade.
crate::availability Query whether a hardware GPU context can be created.
crate::embed Embedded window creation with the shared rendering driver.
crate::engine Engine: text shaping, measuring and fonts for its creating UI thread.
crate::env Environment variable configuration for Arvane.
crate::error Classify external text and rendering failures using shared failure values.
crate::presentation Defines renderer choices and presentation change notifications.
crate::presenter RenderScene presentation and frame policy.
crate::presenter::exports The GPU export pools the window has made, and pending engine notices.
crate::presenter::frame A frame's raster plan, and what presenting it did.
crate::presenter::frame_policy Presenter: one window's renderers and its frame policy.
crate::presenter::gpu A presenter's GPU renderer and its life cycle (`arvane-render`'s feature `gpu`).
crate::presenter::health What a window's surface did with the frames that reached it.
crate::rasterizer CPU image output independent of windows, using the compositor.
crate::spi Backend contracts for platform integrations.
crate::test_font The bundled Tuffy test font, drawn the same on every machine.
crate::window One concrete rendering window and shared backend lifecycle driver.
